item.summary: We asked an unreleased research version of Claude to take a stab at the Riemann hypothesis. It didn’t solve it, but it did make strides on a related problem: it increased the lower bound for the fraction of zeros of the Riemann zeta function that satisfy the hypothesis from 41.6% to 67.2%. anthropic.com/research/riema… 💬 259 🔄 299 ❤️ 3108 👀 307043 📊 620 ⚡ Powered by xgo.ing
